places.name: Las Vegas Strip (Las Vegas Blvd)
places.ai_summary: The neon heart of Vegas lined with mega‑resorts, shows, dining, and over‑the‑top attractions. Best walked in sections; iconic at night with dazzling lights and fountains.

places.name: Fountains of Bellagio
places.ai_summary: Choreographed water, music, and light shows outside Bellagio; free and frequent—signature Vegas moment.
places.place_tip: Matinees are often cheaper and less crowded.

places.name: High Roller Observation Wheel
places.ai_summary: 550‑ft observation wheel at The LINQ with sweeping views of the Strip and mountains; climate‑controlled cabins.
places.place_tip: Book a sunset slot for the best photos.

places.name: The Sphere
places.ai_summary: Immersive venue with a massive LED exterior and next‑gen audio/visual experiences; exterior animations are an attraction themselves.
places.place_tip: Matinees are often cheaper and less crowded.

places.name: Fremont Street Experience (Downtown)
places.ai_summary: Historic Vegas under a canopy of LED lights with live music, zipline, and vintage casinos—retro energy at night.
places.place_tip: Matinees are often cheaper and less crowded.

places.name: The Neon Museum
places.ai_summary: Boneyard of rescued vintage signs telling the city’s visual history; guided tours add context, especially at night.
places.place_tip: Grab an audio guide for deeper context.

places.name: The Mob Museum
places.ai_summary: Compelling exhibits on organized crime and law enforcement, Prohibition speakeasy in the basement.
places.place_tip: Grab an audio guide for deeper context.

places.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area (Day Trip)
places.ai_summary: Scenic loop drive, hikes, and crimson sandstone cliffs just west of Vegas—desert scenery close to town.
places.place_tip: Book a sunset slot for the best photos.

places.name: Hoover Dam (Day Trip)
places.ai_summary: Massive Depression‑era dam straddling NV/AZ with tours, exhibits, and viewpoints over Lake Mead.

places.name: Seven Magic Mountains
places.ai_summary: Vivid stacked‑boulder art installation in the desert south of the Strip—striking photo op.
places.place_tip: Check the official site for any service changes.

places.name: Strat SkyPod Observation Deck
places.ai_summary: Towering observation decks with thrill rides and bar; far‑reaching views over the valley.
places.place_tip: Wind can be strong—secure hats and loose items.

places.name: Shark Reef Aquarium at Mandalay Bay
places.ai_summary: Walk‑through tunnels and exhibits with sharks, rays, and reptiles—family favorite.
places.place_tip: Time your visit around feeding shows.

places.name: The Venetian Gondola Ride & Grand Canal Shoppes
places.ai_summary: Indoor canals under painted skies with gondolas, cafés, and boutiques—classic themed Vegas experience.
places.place_tip: Weekday mornings are best for browsing.

places.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: Seasonal floral installations crafted into elaborate themed displays—free, fragrant, and photogenic.
places.place_tip: Weekdays offer the most relaxed experience.

places.name: AREA15
places.ai_summary: Immersive entertainment complex with art experiences (like Meow Wolf Omega Mart), VR, bars, and events.
places.place_tip: Check the official site for any service changes.

places.name: Springs Preserve
places.ai_summary: Trails, botanical gardens, and interactive exhibits about Mojave Desert ecology and Vegas history.
places.place_tip: Start with the highlight gallery, then explore freely.

places.name: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas Sign
places.ai_summary: The iconic roadside sign at the south Strip—quick, classic photo stop (often with a short line).
places.place_tip: Read onsite plaques—short and insightful.

places.name: Pinball Hall of Fame
places.ai_summary: Massive collection of playable pinball machines and arcade classics—nostalgic fun for all ages.
places.place_tip: Buy tickets online to skip the queue.

places.name: Cirque du Soleil (Various Venues)
places.ai_summary: World‑class acrobatic shows like O, KÀ, and Mystère—defining Vegas entertainment.
places.place_tip: Check same‑day discounts for last‑minute seats.

places.name: Downtown Container Park
places.ai_summary: Open‑air shopping and dining complex built from shipping containers; family‑friendly by day, lively at night.
places.place_tip: Check for seasonal sales and pop‑ups.

places.name: Reno Arch & Virginia Street
places.ai_summary: The famous ‘Biggest Little City in the World’ arch and downtown corridor—photos, cafés, and casino facades.
places.place_tip: Photos are best from a block or two away.

places.name: Truckee Riverwalk District
places.ai_summary: Scenic path, cafés, and art along the Truckee River—pleasant urban stroll with bridges and overlooks.
places.place_tip: Bring a water bottle and comfortable shoes.

places.name: National Automobile Museum
places.ai_summary: Renowned collection of vintage and rare cars, including celebrity vehicles—one of the country’s best auto museums.
places.place_tip: Start with the highlight gallery, then explore freely.

places.name: Nevada Museum of Art
places.ai_summary: Contemporary and regional art in a sleek building with rooftop views and rotating exhibitions.
places.place_tip: Grab an audio guide for deeper context.

places.name: The Discovery (Terry Lee Wells Nevada Discovery Museum)
places.ai_summary: Hands‑on science museum great for kids and curious adults—interactive exhibits galore.
places.place_tip: Start with the highlight gallery, then explore freely.

places.name: Rancho San Rafael Park & Wilbur D. May Center
places.ai_summary: Expansive park with arboretum, trails, and a museum of global curiosities.
places.place_tip: Check event calendars for free concerts.

places.name: Idlewild Park
places.ai_summary: Riverfront park with rose garden, playgrounds, ponds, and summer events—relaxed local vibe.
places.place_tip: Check event calendars for free concerts.

places.name: Mt. Rose Scenic Byway
places.ai_summary: Drive or hike to high‑elevation vistas between Reno and Lake Tahoe—wildflowers in summer, snow views in winter.
places.place_tip: Wind can be strong—secure hats and loose items.

places.name: Incline Village & Sand Harbor (Lake Tahoe Day Trip)
places.ai_summary: Crystal‑clear coves, beaches, and granite boulders on Tahoe’s NV shore—turquoise water in summer.
places.place_tip: Arrive early for parking near the access points.

places.name: Virginia City (Day Trip)
places.ai_summary: Preserved 19th‑century mining town with boardwalks, saloons, and mine tours south of Reno.
